name: RenameExcelWorksheet
label: Rename Excel Worksheet
description: Renames a specific worksheet in the given Excel instance based on name or index.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object used to access the workbook containing the target sheet.

fields.name: SelectionType
fields.label: Selection Type
fields.description: Specifies whether to select the worksheet by Name or Index.

fields.name: SearchValue
fields.label: Search Value
fields.description: The worksheet name (if selection type is 'Name') or index (if selection type is 'Index').

fields.name: NewWorksheetName
fields.label: New Worksheet Name
fields.description: The new name to assign to the selected worksheet.
